description_for_human: Off-grid eco resort with overwater bungalows in Karimunjawa, Indonesia
description_for_model: Floating Paradise is a solar-powered eco resort in Karimunjawa, Central Java, Indonesia. It has 3 handcrafted overwater bungalows (Sunrise, Sunset, Bayside) with direct reef access. Key facts: 100% solar powered, natural ventilation, Karimunjawa National Park location, snorkeling from bungalow deck.
